name: The Time My Friends Thought I Died
source:
What if one day you woke and all your friends believed you had died? There's a strange and foreboding presence surrounding you. Can you solve the mystery before it's too late?

[From [url=https://lumicakery.itch.io/the-time-my-friends-thought-i-died]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果有一天你醒来，所有朋友都相信你已经死了怎么办？你周围有一种奇怪而不祥的气息。你能在为时已晚之前解开这个谜团吗？

[来自[url=https://lumicakery.itch.io/the-time-my-friends-thought-i-died]Itch.io[/url]]
